decisions.name: Atomic explicit default transitions
decisions.contract: On successful app/v1 create or PATCH with default=true, or app mark-default, persist/resolve target and clear other ordinary live defaults atomically under the project lock. Failed validation, duplicate names, or missing/foreign/deleted/triage mark-default targets leave prior defaults unchanged. Missing mark-default target returns 404. default=false may leave zero defaults. Unrelated writes do not repair legacy duplicates. State.default and Project.default_state_id remain distinct.
decisions.oracle: Retain pristine Django records and separately execute patched Django; never rewrite expected records by hand.

decisions.name: UTF-8 JSON
decisions.contract: Use the existing shared djangoinput parser and established UTF-8-only JSON contract. Invalid bytes are rejected before persistence; declared charset labels do not select another decoder.

decisions.name: App create transient order field
decisions.contract: The pristine Django create path accepts order validation then fails with TypeError because State has no order model field. The accepted corrected contract removes order from model creation, attaches it to the returned instance, and returns it in the compact response; order remains distinct from persisted sequence.
decisions.oracle: Preserve the source-observed 500 as the pristine fixture and separately capture the corrected 200 response and unchanged schema through the pinned corrected Django serializer.
